title: Sampled-Replay–Triggered Schema Alerts for Config & Model Rollouts
creator: Aisha K. Morgan
description: Build a lightweight subsystem that ties sampled request replays to configuration/model change events and raises high-confidence schema-violation alerts. Unlike existing detectors that rely solely on aggregated drift signals, this feature replays a bounded set of previously accepted samples through the new config/model variant (shadow/canary) and compares structured outputs against stored golden responses and schema contracts to attribute regressions to specific config diffs or model versions.
acceptance_criteria: Instrument rollout controller to emit change events with config delta metadata (model_id, model_hash, quantization_profile, runtime_flags)
Implement sample-selector that cheaply selects representative golden samples per route with coverage across fields and arrays (<=1000 samples per route)
Replay path that can run shadow inference for a config/model variant and compute fieldwise diffs, schema validation errors, and a synthesized severity score
Alerting rule: if severity_score > 0.25 AND schema_violation_rate increases by >= 3x over baseline within a 30-minute window, emit an incident with attributed config delta
Integrate results into Console: per-route delta view, top-10 affected fields, example before/after pairs, and link to Replay job artifacts
End-to-end test: synthetic canary that injects an intentional field rename causing >40% field-mismatch — system must detect and produce an alert and rollback suggestion
implementation_notes: Telemetry metrics to emit: schema_violation_rate_by_config_version, per_field_null_increase, array_length_shift_p95, avg_parse_errors, field_entropy_delta
Scoring: combine weighted factors (validation_fail=0.6, field_presence_change=0.2, semantic_token_shift=0.2) to create severity_score
Storage: use existing eval-sample-store with TTL 90 days; compressed JSON with SHA256 id and route metadata
Sampling: stratified by route, prompt-length bucket, and production traffic weight to avoid sampling bias
Privacy: store redacted prompts; ensure PII scrubber runs before storing samples to comply with Private deployments
Performance: replay job should target 200 qps for shadow runs using batched inference where possible and should not affect primary inference latency
progress_updates: 2026-02-22 — Kickoff: scoped to Console-integrated alert + replay runner. PM/Design alignment meeting completed. Agreed to start with host API routes only (no dedicated/private rollout integration yet).

2026-02-28 — Prototype: implemented sample-selector that returns 500 stratified samples per route. Initial golden store schema committed in repo: github.com/redwood-inference/replay-golden-store PR #2174.

2026-03-03 — Design review: Console wireframes for 'Replay Delta' panel reviewed with Design (Maya). Feedback: show top-3 human-readable examples first, collapse raw JSON by default. Action: update panel mockups.
2026-03-05 — Security sync: discussed PII redaction and consent; Security requested an opt-in for Private deployments and audit logging for sample access. Marked security_review_required = true.
